conditions.meaning: Reports whether the operator verified the snapshot artifacts and committed the parent snapshot publication.

example.introduction: The operator verified the result and committed its publication on the parent snapshot.
example.nextCheck: Match the condition generation to the snapshot generation, then read the result from the parent’s publication.
example.title: When publication completes

narrative: Before publication, conditions can be empty. If `status.activeBuildRef` is present, inspect the active build. A failed or cancelled attempt can retain the active claim while cleanup is uncertain. Once the claim is released, check `status.failure` and `status.lastBuildRef`. The source selection and resolution describe what the snapshot reads. A committed publication identifies the resulting table data. [SnapshotBuild conditions](/reference/kubernetes/data.prokrust.ai/v1beta1/snapshotbuild/#conditions)

outcomes.guidance: Read `status.publication.result` for the verified result and `status.publication.root` for the commit record. The producer build UID identifies the attempt.
